question: What happens when one always contemplates smoke-colored form?
premises: dhūmra varṇaṃ sadā cintya means always contemplate smoke-colored
trailokyaṃ cālayet means shakes triple world
inference: Always contemplating smoke-colored form shakes the triple world, O beloved.
uncertainties: whether dhūmra varṇaṃ is object of cintya
plain_english: Always contemplating smoke-colored form shakes the triple world, O beloved.
